title.zh-TW: 被推薦人註冊後六個月內 20% 交易手續費折扣
title.en: 20% trading fee discount for six months after registering

text.zh-TW: 依官方超級推薦計畫頁（2026-10-28 讀取）；補填推薦碼也有，期間從註冊日起算。以 MAX 官方公告為準。
text.en: Per the official Super Referral Program page (read 2026-10-28); a code added later counts too, from the registration date. MAX's announcements prevail.

title.zh-TW: 可搭配 MAX Token 折抵手續費
title.en: Can be combined with MAX Token fee offsets

text.zh-TW: 官方頁面寫「被推薦人 8 折，搭配 MAX Token 折抵，立享雙重折扣」，沒有列出合計折扣率，本站不推算。
text.en: The official page says invited users get 20% off and can combine it with MAX Token offsets, but it lists no combined rate, so this site does not calculate one.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（推薦碼 89225d4a 已在連結中，會在新分頁開啟）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (referral code 89225d4a is already in it; it opens in a new tab).

steps.zh-TW: 在註冊頁輸入電子郵件；頁面會顯示有人邀請你加入 MAX，代表推薦碼已經帶入。
steps.en: Enter your email on the sign-up page; the page shows that someone invites you to join MAX, which means the code was carried over.

steps.zh-TW: 依畫面指示完成註冊；註冊前先確認網址列的網域是 maicoin.com 底下的 max.maicoin.com。
steps.en: Follow the screens to finish registering; first check that the address bar shows max.maicoin.com, a domain under maicoin.com.

steps.zh-TW: 若註冊時沒有帶入推薦碼，註冊後到「使用者」的「分享推薦連結」，按「設定推薦人」補填（設定後不能更改）。
steps.en: If the code was not carried over, add it after registering: go to User, then Share referral link, then Set referrer (it cannot be changed once set).

intro.zh-TW: MAX 數位資產交易所，提供比特幣、以太幣、USDT 等熱門交易對。依官方推薦計畫，被推薦人註冊後六個月內享 20% 交易手續費折扣。
intro.en: MAX digital asset exchange with pairs such as BTC, ETH and USDT. Per the official referral program, invited users get a 20% trading fee discount for six months.

description.zh-TW:
MAX 是 MaiCoin 旗下的數位資產交易所（網站頁尾署名現代財富科技股份有限公司）。官網簡介寫明提供比特幣、以太幣、USDT 等熱門虛擬貨幣交易對，並稱資金信託保管；這是平台自述，本站沒有查證信託的實際安排。官方「法定揭露事項」頁另列有洗錢防制登記核准文號與日期、收費政策、資訊安全政策、法幣資產信託銀行資訊與資產儲備證明報告等文件，註冊前可以先看。MaiCoin 也在台北設有實體門市（台北市中正區八德路一段 104 號），提供數位資產平台的介紹、新手教學與開戶協助。

這個邀請連結已經帶有推薦碼 89225d4a（網址中的 r 參數）。本站 2026-10-28 用英文介面開啟連結，註冊頁顯示有人邀請你加入 MAX（Invite you to join MAX）；官方推薦計畫頁把這組代碼稱為「推薦碼」，分享頁則寫「邀請碼」，兩者是同一組。

依官方「超級推薦計畫」頁（2026-10-28 讀取）：被推薦人註冊後六個月內享 20% 交易手續費折扣；推薦人可獲得好友交易手續費 20% 的返佣，鎖倉 5,000 MAX Token 以上可提高到 50%，返佣一律以 MAX Token 發放；被推薦人須有交易，推薦人才會收到獎勵。若註冊時沒有帶入推薦碼，可在註冊後補填（到「使用者」的「分享推薦連結」，按「設定推薦人」），設定後不能更改，也只能綁定比自己早註冊的人；折扣期間仍從註冊日起算六個月，不是從補填日起算。

MAX 保留隨時調整返佣比例與規則的權利及最終解釋權，發現異常操作時返佣與折扣會被取消。實際內容、金額與期限以 MAX 官方公告為準。註冊前先確認網址列的網域是 maicoin.com 底下的官方網域。
description.en:
MAX is a digital asset exchange run under MaiCoin (the site footer is signed 現代財富科技股份有限公司). Its site description says it offers popular trading pairs such as Bitcoin, Ether and USDT and that funds are held in trust; this is the platform's own statement, and this site has not checked the trust arrangements. The official statutory disclosures page also lists documents such as the anti-money-laundering registration approval number and date, the fee policy, the information security policy, trust bank information for fiat assets and proof-of-reserves reports, which are worth reading before you sign up. MaiCoin also runs a physical store in Taipei (No. 104, Sec. 1, Bade Rd., Zhongzheng Dist., Taipei City) that offers platform introductions, beginner tutorials and help with opening an account.

The referral link on this page already carries the referral code 89225d4a (the r parameter in the address). On 2026-10-28 this site opened the link in the English interface, and the sign-up page showed that someone invites you to join MAX ("Invite you to join MAX"). The official referral program page calls the code a "referral code" (推薦碼) while the share page says "invitation code" (邀請碼); they are the same code.

According to the official Super Referral Program page (read on 2026-10-28): an invited user gets a 20% trading fee discount for six months after registering. The referrer earns a 20% rebate on the friend's trading fees, which can rise to 50% when 5,000 MAX Tokens or more are locked, always paid in MAX Token, and the referrer is rewarded only after the invited user has traded. If the code was not filled in at sign-up, it can be added afterwards (go to User, then Share referral link, then Set referrer); once set it cannot be changed, and you can only bind someone who registered earlier than you. The discount period still runs six months from the registration date, not from the day the code is added.

MAX may change rebate rates and rules at any time and keeps the final right of interpretation; abnormal activity can cancel rebates and discounts. Actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow MAX's official announcements. Before you sign up, check that the domain in the address bar is an official domain under maicoin.com.

notes.zh-TW: 資料取自 MAX 的官方超級推薦計畫頁、官網簡介、法定揭露事項頁與門市頁（2026-10-28 讀取）。本站沒有實際註冊與交易，折扣的實際計算與生效時間、補填畫面的名稱都沒有驗證。官方頁面主視覺寫「獲得最高 50% 返佣」與「被推薦人 8 折」，本站只採用說明文字列出的 20% 與六個月；推薦人的 50% 需要鎖倉 5,000 MAX Token 以上。MAX 保留隨時調整返佣比例與規則的權利及最終解釋權；發現異常操作時，返佣與折扣都會被取消。MAX 簡介中的資金信託保管、法定揭露頁列出的登記與報告，都是平台自己公布的資料，本站沒有向主管機關或信託銀行查證。加密資產價格波動大，可能損失本金；請自行確認所在地區的法規與平台服務範圍。
notes.en: Data comes from MAX's official Super Referral Program page, site description, statutory disclosures page and store page (read on 2026-10-28). This site has not registered or traded, so how the discount is actually calculated and when it takes effect, and the screen names for adding a code later, are unverified. The official page headlines "up to 50% rebate" and "invited users pay 80%"; this site uses only the 20% and six months listed in the text, and the referrer's 50% requires locking 5,000 MAX Tokens or more. MAX may change rebate rates and rules at any time and keeps the final right of interpretation; abnormal activity cancels rebates and discounts. The trust custody in the site description and the registrations and reports on the disclosures page are published by the platform itself and have not been checked with a regulator or trust bank. Crypto assets are volatile and you can lose your capital; check the law where you live and whether the platform serves your region.

q.zh-TW: MAX 邀請碼要輸入在哪裡？
q.en: Where do I enter the MAX referral code?

a.zh-TW: 不需要手動輸入：推薦碼 89225d4a 已經在連結的 r 參數中，用本頁的邀請連結開啟註冊頁即可，頁面會顯示有人邀請你加入 MAX。若註冊時沒有帶入，官方說明可以在註冊後補填（到「使用者」的「分享推薦連結」，按「設定推薦人」）。本站沒有實際註冊，補填畫面的名稱以 MAX 為準。
a.en: You do not need to type it: the referral code 89225d4a is already in the link's r parameter, so open the sign-up page through the link on this page and it shows that someone invites you to join MAX. If it was not carried over, the official page says you can add it after registering (go to User, then Share referral link, then Set referrer). This site has not registered, so the exact screen names follow MAX.

q.zh-TW: MAX 的邀請碼和推薦碼是同一個嗎？
q.en: Are the MAX invitation code and referral code the same?

a.zh-TW: 是。MAX 官方的超級推薦計畫頁稱為「推薦碼」，分享頁與分享文案寫「邀請碼」，指的都是同一組代碼 89225d4a。
a.en: Yes. MAX's Super Referral Program page says "referral code" (推薦碼) while the share page and share text say "invitation code" (邀請碼); both mean the same code, 89225d4a.

q.zh-TW: 註冊時沒有帶入推薦碼，還能補填嗎？
q.en: Can I add the referral code after registering?

a.zh-TW: 可以，但有限制。官方說明：登入後到「使用者」的「分享推薦連結」，按「設定推薦人」補填；設定後不能再更改推薦人，而且只能綁定比自己早註冊的人。補填也享有 20% 手續費折扣，期間從註冊日起算六個月，不是從補填日起算。
a.en: Yes, with limits. The official page says to log in, go to User, then Share referral link, then Set referrer. Once set, the referrer cannot be changed, and you can only bind someone who registered earlier than you. A late code also gets the 20% fee discount, and the six months count from the registration date, not from the day you add it.

q.zh-TW: 被推薦人的手續費折扣是多少、多久？
q.en: How large is the invitee fee discount and how long does it last?

a.zh-TW: 依官方超級推薦計畫頁（2026-10-28 讀取）：註冊後六個月內，交易手續費享 20% 折扣。官方頁面另寫「被推薦人 8 折，搭配 MAX Token 折抵，立享雙重折扣」，沒有列出合計折扣率。MAX 保留隨時調整比例與規則的權利，實際以官方公告為準。
a.en: Per the official Super Referral Program page (read 2026-10-28): a 20% trading fee discount for six months after registering. The page also says invited users get 20% off and can combine it with MAX Token offsets, but lists no combined rate. MAX may change rates and rules at any time, so follow its official announcements.

q.zh-TW: 邀請碼無法使用怎麼辦？
q.en: What if the referral code is not accepted?

a.zh-TW: 先確認填入的是 89225d4a，並依原樣輸入（注意英文大小寫）；再確認網址列的網域是 maicoin.com 底下的官方網域，然後重新從本頁的邀請連結進入。補填時只能綁定比自己早註冊的人。若仍然無法使用，請參考 MAX 官方網站的說明。
a.en: Check that you entered 89225d4a exactly as shown, including upper and lower case. Then check that the domain in the address bar is an official domain under maicoin.com, and open the sign-up page again from the referral link on this page. When adding a code later, you can only bind someone who registered earlier than you. If it still does not work, refer to the information on the official MAX website.

q.en: Does MAX have a physical store?

a.zh-TW: MaiCoin 在台北設有實體門市，地址是台北市中正區八德路一段 104 號，提供數位資產平台的介紹、新手教學與開戶協助。官方門市頁（2026-10-28 讀取）寫營業時間為週一至週日 12:00 至 20:00，實際以官方門市頁為準。
a.en: MaiCoin runs a physical store in Taipei at No. 104, Sec. 1, Bade Rd., Zhongzheng Dist., Taipei City, offering platform introductions, beginner tutorials and help with opening an account. The official store page (read 2026-10-28) lists opening hours of Monday to Sunday, 12:00 to 20:00; follow the official store page for current hours.
